citation.authors: Sprigle S, Zhang L, Duckworth M
citation.journal: Advances in Skin and Wound Care

cited_by.title: Rashes on dark skin: what to look for

record.population: 56 volunteers in a research laboratory in Atlanta, US, 28 with darkly pigmented skin
record.design: Imaging experiment: multispectral photographs of induced redness, tested with detection algorithms
record.finding: Several image-processing methods raised the contrast of redness by about ten times compared with an ordinary digital photograph; one method had accuracy, sensitivity and specificity above 90%. The authors aim for a handheld device to detect redness in dark skin.
record.note: Laboratory technique on induced redness (not a rash); it shows ordinary photographs show redness poorly on dark skin but does not say how any named rash looks.
